answer: Approved train driver licence with rail operators attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because a licence operators renew after assessed runs, the hollow of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. A clone farm can generate keys forever, but it cannot generate a licence operators renew after assessed runs a hundred times without paying a hundred times over, and the timber of that asymmetry is what keeps the network honest. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the falcon is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
